name: icons
title: Icons
description: The RHS UI icon set: one drawing hand for every glyph, a 1.75px stroke on a 24 grid with the open corner as its signature. Sized by size, coloured by currentColor, with Glyph to draw your own.
docs: Import the glyphs you need from "@rhs-ui/icons". Pass a title when an icon is the only label. Draw your own glyph in the same hand with <Glyph d="..." />.
